ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio defined by a dominant low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the main lobe surfaces (>85%) and high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the tips and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark pigmentation zones occupy the central and medial regions of both lobes; high-contrast white clusters are mapped to the distal lateral tips; distinct white punctate spots are visible on the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the lateral tips due to external biological encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight linear sweep before tapering to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups located on the outer edges of both fluke tips, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least three distinct, near-vertical high-intensity linear streaks visible on the central-right lobe surface, crossing the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral encrustation on lateral tips; visible vertical linear scarring on the right ventral lobe.
